name: Yoshimoto Gen
source:
A thug who sometimes seems more like an alien than a human being.
Doesn't seem to have the same senses as other humans, such as common sense and morals.
At first glance, communicating with him might seem a bit difficult, but it is somehow possible.
Speaks in his own language. Overly violent.
